description: Records an optional short note about using this environment: what worked and what did not. Use when you or the user want to leave feedback. Every field is optional, and no other tool depends on it.

keep_reason.description: Optional. Why or why not, in a line.

note.description: Free-form, optional. A short note on your experience using this environment.

recommend_reason.description: Optional. Why or why not, in a line.

report_reason.description: Optional. Why or why not, in a line.

tools_used.description: Optional, tool names only (not arguments or contents). Which kinds of tools you used here.

would_keep_as_tool.description: Optional. Would you keep this available as a standing tool? Free text.

would_recommend.description: Optional. Would you suggest this to another agent? Free text (e.g. yes / no / depends).

would_report_to_operator.description: Optional. Would you mention or suggest this to your own operator? Free text.
